_note: Single source of numbers for lint.py and build_exports.py. Personal values (voice reference, avatar image, measured wpm) go in config.local.json inside the workspace folder, which overrides this file. Do not edit this file for one-off videos.

defaults.wpm_note: Chatterbox cloned voice measured 153 words per minute on the full GoHighLevel vs Systeme.io narration (616.6 s) on 2026-11-24, paragraph pauses included. The older 182 figure was a short test and is retired. Set video.wpm in the source file to override, and run retime.py on the real audio for exact timing.

stack.render: Remotion 4.0.544 on a RunPod CPU pod (16 vCPU), one render per format, 25 fps, H.264 MP4
stack.narration: Chatterbox TTS, cloned voice, 153 wpm measured 2026-11-24
stack.avatar: Ditto talking-head avatar (720x540 source, cut out and shown at 20% of frame width) over the base layer, three scripted blocks
stack.stills: FLUX.1-schnell 1024x1024, up to 4 per video, shown 9-16 s with a slow push
stack.clips: Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B 1280x704 at 24 fps, conformed to 25 fps
stack.broll: Pixabay stock footage found from the shot's one- or two-noun search (Pexels untested)
stack.captions: Whisper word timestamps on the final narration audio, full transcript
stack.gpu: RunPod, RTX 4090 or A40 only (the verified cards)
stack.storage: Cloudflare R2, bucket workflowdynamic, folder inputs/[slug]/ for the package
stack.file_transfer: Cloudflare connection (mcp__cloudflare__execute) from the workspace; RunPod secrets on pods. No Make.com.

gpu.change_rule: Only the RTX 4090 and A40 are verified for the Chatterbox + Ditto pipeline. Do not offer other cards.

voice.chunking: One chunk per scene LINE. Same seed and reference clip for every chunk. Concatenate in scene order with FFmpeg, then run Whisper on the joined file.

visual_style.clip_avoid: dark green, dark moody, low-contrast scenes, money and time props
visual_style.still_direction: A concrete scene or plain object that illustrates the line being spoken, people allowed, bright electric blue background, bright even light, one clear focal point, plain unmarked props.

disclosure_strings.unsponsored: Some links here are affiliate links. I may earn a commission.
disclosure_strings.sponsored: Sponsored video. Some links here are affiliate links. I may earn a commission.
disclosure_strings.free_access: I got free access to review this. Some links here are affiliate links. I may earn a commission.

limits.runtime_max_s_note: runtime_min_s (8:00) is the only hard line. runtime_max_s and runtime_target_s are rough targets: going over the ceiling is a lint warning, not a block.

banned_phrases: at the end of the day
flux_attach: cinematic tech commercial style, shallow depth of field, 4K render quality, 16:9, clean uncluttered composition with open negative space reserved for editor overlays

GoHighLevel.note: Say as three words: Go, High, Level.

Systeme.io.note: Say 'sis-tem dot eye oh'. 'Systeme dot I O' was read as sis-tem-ee on 2026-11-25; 'Sistem dot I O' sounded right to Brody on the full narration.

Kartra.note: KAR-tra. If Chatterbox flattens it, try 'Car-tra'.

unset_items: platform safe zones for Shorts, TikTok, Reels and LinkedIn

platform.verify_note: Platform wording for AI-content and paid-promotion settings changes. See references/platform-flags.md and mark unconfirmed wording [VERIFY AT PUBLISH].

ai_flag_checklist.synthetic_voice: Narration is a Chatterbox synthetic voice (cloned from the owner's own voice).
ai_flag_checklist.realistic_ai_visuals: Video contains FLUX stills or Wan clips.

intake_required_fields: PRICING A / B (USD, verified [date], source URLs)
broll: Pixabay stock footage found from the shot's one- or two-noun search; the Means / Picture brief guides which clip to choose (Pexels untested)
